notes: Hybrid: groups 0-2 GDN (MambaSpec, Checkpoint(528)), group 3 full attention, block 528. Align mode is what vLLM 0.32 forces with prefix caching; pinned explicitly. Retention 528 makes vLLM retain (and offer to connectors) the state at every block end, for every arm. Not batch invariant: vLLM 0.32's selector rejects VLLM_BATCH_INVARIANT for Mamba backends without supports_batch_invariance, and GDN has none; plain vLLM batched vs alone flips a completion (P5 it2 leg 1, 2026-10-24-qwen3.5-4b-p5-it2-ctrl). Split invariant per the same control (no divergence at 1056 / 1584); both claims are measured in every run (G2.batch_control, G2.split_control). Compilation mode 0 (no torch.compile; CUDA graphs kept): an inductor compile of this model is not reproducible (two fresh compiles of the same config give different logits at concurrency 1), and vLLM caches the first compile per config hash, which includes kv_transfer_config, so arms with and without a connector would run different kernels (plain vs baseline logprobs differ from token 0). With mode 0 plain, baseline and a repeat give identical logprobs (GPU5 probe, 2026-10-24).
